{{Quote|The big targets are ours.|Anonymous 2-M unit commander|<ref name="Star Wars: Empire at War">''[[Star Wars: Empire at War]]''</ref>}}
The '''2-M ''Saber''-class repulsor tank''', or simply '''2-M repulsor tank''', was a ground-based [[Hovertank/Legends|fighter tank]] produced by [[Rothana Heavy Engineering/Legends|Rothana Heavy Engineering]] and used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] to combat Rebel armor and infantry.

==Description==
Like the earlier [[TX-130 Saber-class fighter tank/Legends|TX-130S]] and [[TX-130T fighter tank|TX-130T]] tank models, the 2-M tank was outfitted with [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]] and a [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] drive often augmented by the additional power boosters carried onboard as backup to the main repulsorlift battery. It was armed with a powerful rotating medium [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]], an anti-infantry cannon, and dual missile launchers.

==History==
Based on the design of the TX-130T fighter tank, itself an upgraded version of the TX-130 ''Saber''-class fighter tank, the 2-M was designed to counteract [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] deployment of the [[T2-B Repulsor Tank/Legends|T2-B repulsor tank]]. Initial field tests proved the 2-M was superior to that earlier model.<ref name="EAWGG" /><ref name="DB" />

Despite the 2-M's tactical advantage over the Rebel T2-B, their expense and periods of long maintenance led to limited use of the 2-M tank during the [[The galaxy/Legends|Galactic]] Civil War.<ref name="EAWGG" /><ref name="DB" />

A [[Scout/Legends|scout]] variant of this vehicle, the [[Scout-class 2-M repulsor tank/Legends|SC2-M Repulsor Tank]], was later created.<ref name="FiB" />
